Mountain Adventures
Coastal Escapes
Wine Regions

Discover Georgia's incredible diversity with these carefully curated day trips and weekend getaways. From ancient cave cities to pristine mountain peaks and world-class wine regions.

Filter by Season

Batumi & Black Sea Coast

380 km from Tbilisi2-3 dayseasy
4.8
₾₾

Georgia's premier seaside resort with beautiful beaches, modern architecture, and vibrant nightlife.

Highlights:

  • •Batumi Boulevard seaside promenade
  • •Modern architectural landmarks
  • •Batumi Botanical Garden

Transportation:

cartrainbus
Best Time:

May-October for beach activities, year-round for sightseeing

Budget Stay:

₾40-80/night

Mid-range:

₾80-150/night

Luxury:

₾150-300/night

Pro Tips:
  • • Book accommodation in advance during summer
  • • Try Adjarian khachapuri (cheese boat)

Kazbegi & Mount Kazbek

165 km from Tbilisi1-2 daysmoderate
4.9
₾₾

Dramatic mountain scenery with the iconic Gergeti Trinity Church and views of Mount Kazbek.

Highlights:

  • •Gergeti Trinity Church (14th century)
  • •Mount Kazbek views (5,047m)
  • •Dariali Gorge

Transportation:

carbus
Best Time:

May-October (snow possible other months)

Budget Stay:

₾30-60/night

Mid-range:

₾60-120/night

Luxury:

₾120-250/night

Pro Tips:
  • • Bring warm clothes even in summer
  • • Hire 4WD taxi to reach Trinity Church

Sighnaghi & Kakheti Wine Region

110 km from Tbilisi1-2 dayseasy
4.7
₾₾

Charming hilltop town known as the "City of Love" surrounded by Georgia's premier wine region.

Highlights:

  • •Sighnaghi old town and city walls
  • •Wine tastings at local wineries
  • •Bodbe Monastery

Transportation:

carbustour
Best Time:

April-October (harvest season: September-October)

Budget Stay:

₾25-50/night

Mid-range:

₾50-100/night

Luxury:

₾100-200/night

Pro Tips:
  • • Book wine tours in advance
  • • Try traditional Georgian feast (supra)

Planning Your Trip

Transportation

  • • Rent a car for maximum flexibility
  • • Marshrutkas (minibuses) are budget-friendly
  • • Book train tickets in advance
  • • Consider guided tours for wine regions

Best Times

  • • Spring (Apr-May): Mild weather, fewer crowds
  • • Summer (Jun-Aug): Peak season, all activities
  • • Autumn (Sep-Oct): Wine harvest, great weather
  • • Winter (Nov-Mar): Skiing, indoor attractions

Budget Tips

  • • Guesthouses offer authentic experiences
  • • Try local restaurants for better prices
  • • Many attractions have free entry
  • • Group tours can be cost-effective
